correct.zh: 并联（冗余）结构的可用率，是用整体减去两台同时停机的概率来求得的。装置A的可用率为0.9，所以停机概率为 1−0.9＝0.1，两台都停机的概率为 0.1×0.1＝0.01，因此并联部分的可用率为 1−0.01＝0.99。再乘以串联的装置B（0.8），图1的系统可用率为 0.99×0.8＝0.792，将小数第3位四舍五入后得 0.79。图2是装置A一台与装置B串联，因此为 0.9×0.8＝0.72。所以下降量为 0.79−0.72＝0.07，正确答案是ア。
correct.en: For a parallel (redundant) configuration, the availability is obtained by subtracting the probability that both units are down at the same time from the whole. Device A has an availability of 0.9, so its failure probability is 1−0.9＝0.1, and the probability that both units are down is 0.1×0.1＝0.01; therefore the availability of the parallel section is 1−0.01＝0.99. Multiplying this by device B (0.8), which is connected in series, the system availability in Figure 1 is 0.99×0.8＝0.792, which becomes 0.79 after rounding off the third decimal place. Figure 2 is one device A in series with device B, so it is 0.9×0.8＝0.72. The decrease is therefore 0.79−0.72＝0.07, and the correct answer is ア.

distractors.zh: 0.09 是只比较装置A部分所得到的差（并联部分 0.99 − 一台 0.90＝0.09）。题目问的是包含装置B在内的整个系统可用率的下降量，所以必须乘上装置B的可用率0.8，即 0.09×0.8＝0.072，也就是约0.07。这是漏乘了串联的装置B的值。
distractors.en: 0.09 is the difference obtained by comparing only the device A part (parallel section 0.99 − one unit 0.90＝0.09). What the question asks for is the decrease in the availability of the whole system including device B, so it must be multiplied by device B's availability of 0.8, giving 0.09×0.8＝0.072, that is, about 0.07. This value forgets to multiply by device B, which is in series.

distractors.zh: 0.10 是把装置A一台的停机概率 1−0.9＝0.1 直接当作系统下降量的值。即使去掉一台冗余，只要剩下的一台仍在运行系统就能工作，因此失去的是两台结构与一台结构的可用率之差（0.99−0.90＝0.09），而且还需要再乘以装置B。0.1 是没有依据的、过大的值。
distractors.en: 0.10 is the value obtained by treating the failure probability of a single device A, 1−0.9＝0.1, directly as the system's decrease. Even if one redundant unit is removed, the system keeps working as long as the remaining unit is running, so what is lost is the difference in availability between the two-unit and the one-unit configuration (0.99−0.90＝0.09), and it still has to be multiplied by device B. 0.1 is a value that is too large and has no basis.

distractors.zh: 0.45 的数量级就不对。把冗余的装置A减少一台所失去的量，上限也只是装置A部分的差 0.99−0.90＝0.09 乘以装置B的0.8 得到的 0.072，而且本来也不过是图1的系统可用率 0.79 与图2的 0.72 之差。0.45 超过它的6倍，在任何计算路径下都不可能出现。
distractors.en: 0.45 is off by an order of magnitude. The amount lost by reducing the redundant device A to one unit is at most 0.072, obtained by multiplying the difference in the device A part, 0.99−0.90＝0.09, by device B's 0.8; and in the first place it is only the difference between the system availability of 0.79 in Figure 1 and 0.72 in Figure 2. 0.45 is more than six times that, and cannot arise by any route of calculation.

points.zh: 并联（冗余）结构的可用率为 1−(1−可用率A)×(1−可用率B)，串联结构的可用率为 可用率A×可用率B。并联的诀窍是先把各自的停机概率相乘。
points.en: The availability of a parallel (redundant) configuration is 1−(1−availability A)×(1−availability B), and the availability of a series configuration is availability A × availability B. The trick for the parallel case is to multiply the failure probabilities together first.

points.zh: 混合结构要按照「先把并联部分合并成一个可用率，再按串联相乘」的顺序来计算。此外还要确认题目问的是单个装置的值，还是整个系统的值。
points.en: For a mixed configuration, calculate in this order: first combine the parallel block into a single availability, then multiply it in series. Also check whether what is being asked is the value of an individual device or the value of the whole system.
